subject: Mathematics

show.line: Cut a pizza into two equal pieces. Each piece is a half. Four equal pieces? Each is a quarter!

rounds.prompt: Which shape is cut into halves? Two equal parts.
Which chocolate is cut into quarters? Four equal parts.
This bread is cut into three equal pieces. What is each piece called? Say it.
Which shape has one half coloured in?
rounds.praise: Yes! One of two equal parts is coloured.

rounds.prompt: Is this cut fairly into halves? Tap yes or no.
rounds.praise: No! Halves must be the same size.

rounds.prompt: Halves or quarters? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Count the pieces. Two pieces are halves. Four pieces are quarters.
The pieces must all be the same size.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this piece of pizza.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The pizza is in four pieces. This piece is a half!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Four equal pieces. Each one is a quarter.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the pieces together. One, two, three, four. Quarters!

parent_line: Can recognise halves, thirds and quarters in pictures.
